Inside the app

A feed that feels alive, tools that make every post look intentional, and an AI that quietly keeps the whole place humming.

Discover feed, curated by AI

Your home feed is assembled by Trendly's AI around what you actually watch, like, and save — viral videos and photo posts from creators across the platform, refreshed all day so there's always something new catching on.

Trends board that looks beyond the app

Trendly's trend scout researches what's moving across TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Google Trends, and the news, then brings fresh topics onto the board — so you spot the next wave while it's still forming out in the wider web.

Trendies — here for 24 hours, gone tomorrow

Post a Trendie and it lives at the top of Discover for a single day. The clock keeps things raw, fast, and honest — no endless polishing, just what you're making right now.

A camera that shoots in your style

Film or snap right inside Trendly with live filter preview, record video up to 60 seconds, then trim, cut, and score it in the built-in editor — eight built-in music tracks across Upbeat, Chill, Dramatic, and Fun moods, no licensing headaches.

Creators who get it

Follow creators, trade likes, comments, and saves, and build a circle of like-minded people. Every new account starts with a first friend already waiting — Heather, the creator behind Trendly, at @Heather2on.

An AI Center working for you

Trendly's AI curates the feed, reviews reported posts and settles disputes with a logged decision, and sits in the composer with content ideas when you're stuck on what to make next.

Thirty-one filters. Every look you want.

Every photo post, Trendie, and camera shot can wear one of Trendly's 31 filters — the original 13, 10 new trending looks, and 8 game filters. Try them here, then use the exact same filters live in the composer above.

From the soft grain of Vintage to Cyberpunk Neon and HUD Vision, every filter below applies live in the composer preview, on photo posts in your feed, and in the full-screen Trendie viewer.

Everything's free — for now

$0— free while we grow

Trendly is free until it gets more traffic. No subscription, no card, no paywall — every feature below is included for everyone right now. Paid plans may come later once the community is bigger, but early creators are in free today.

  • Fire Trend advantage — the daily spotlight, the full Trends board, and one-tap posting on every rising topic.
  • All 31 filters in the camera and on photo posts — the original 13 plus new trending looks and game filters like Cyberpunk Neon, Retro Arcade, and HUD Vision.
  • The full studio kit — in-app camera, 60-second video, the trim-and-cut editor, and all eight built-in music tracks.
  • AI in your corner — a curated feed, content ideas in the composer, and fair, logged dispute reviews.
  • Trendies that stand out — 24-hour posts at the top of Discover, in front of everyone, every day.
